Off-season strength – 4 day split

Day 1 (Lower)
A1. Back squat 5 x 3 @ 85%, rest 3 min
A2. Nordic curl 3 x 5
B. Walking lunge 3 x 10/leg
C. Sled push 6 x 20m

Day 2 (Upper)
Bench press 4 x 6 @ RPE 8
Chin ups 4 x max
Single arm DB row 3 x 10 each arm, tempo 3-1-1
Neck harness 2 x 25

Day 3 – Conditioning
Assault bike 10 x 30s on / 30s off
Easy jog 20 min

Day 4 – Recovery
Mobility flow 15 min. Breathe through the nose the whole time.
